style.gf-root-footer-wrapper: width: 100%; border-block-start-width: 1px; background-color: #F4F4F5; display: flex; justify-content: center; border-top-style: solid; border-top-color: #E4E4E7;
style.gf-footer-inner-boxed: width: 100%; max-width: 1320px; padding-block-start: 60px; padding-block-end: 24px; padding-inline-start: 24px; padding-inline-end: 24px; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
style.gf-footer-top-columns: width: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: row; gap: 32px; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start;
style.gf-col-branding:
max-width: 320px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; flex: 1 1 280px;
@media(--mobile) { max-width: 100%; }
style.gf-col-brand-header: display: flex; flex-direction: row; gap: 12px; align-items: center;
style.gf-col-brand-badge: font-family: "Open Sans"; font-weight: 800; font-size: 11px; color: #374151; letter-spacing: 0.8px; margin: 0px;
style.gf-col-brand-tagline: font-family: "Open Sans"; font-weight: 400; font-size: 11px; color: #6B7280; margin: 0px;
style.gf-col-brand-desc: font-family: "Open Sans"; font-size: 13px; color: #4B5563; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0px;
style.gf-col-brand-social-title: font-family: "Open Sans"; font-weight: 800; font-size: 11px; color: #18181B; letter-spacing: 0.8px; text-transform: uppercase; margin-block-start: 12px; margin-block-end: 0px;
style.gf-col-brand-social-row: display: flex; flex-direction: row; gap: 8px; align-items: center;
style.gf-col-nav: display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; flex: 1 1 180px;
style.gf-col-nav-title: font-family: "Open Sans"; font-weight: 800; font-size: 12px; color: #18181B; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0px;
style.gf-col-empresas: display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; flex: 1 1 180px;
style.gf-col-empresas-title: font-family: "Open Sans"; font-weight: 800; font-size: 12px; color: #18181B; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0px;
style.gf-col-ubicacion: display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; flex: 1 1 180px;
style.gf-col-ubicacion-title: font-family: "Open Sans"; font-weight: 800; font-size: 12px; color: #18181B; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0px;
style.gf-col-horarios: display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; flex: 1 1 180px;
style.gf-col-horarios-title: font-family: "Open Sans"; font-weight: 800; font-size: 12px; color: #18181B; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0px;
style.gf-footer-sublegal:
width: 100%; padding-block-start: 24px; margin-block-start: 40px; border-block-start-width: 1px; display: flex; flex-direction: row; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; border-top-style: solid; border-top-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
@media(--mobile) { text-align: center; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
